analysis.summary: This CV was optimized to highlight Tomas's strongest documented skills in financial analysis, forecasting, and data-driven reporting, which represent his genuine transferable value. However, the job description for Airbnb's Senior Program Manager, Workplace Operations requires a fundamentally different skill set (program management, workplace operations, vendor management, change management, AI/automation tooling) that is not present in the applicant's source documents, resulting in a low ATS compatibility score.
key_changes: Repositioned 'variance analysis' as the one verified matching skill, placing it prominently in the skills section and summary.
Strengthened experience bullets with specific, verified achievements such as forecast accuracy improvement and month-end close reduction using only numbers confirmed in the source CV.
Consolidated the skills section into clear, ATS-readable categories using only tools and competencies explicitly documented in the source CVs.
Removed the Finance Intern role at Lakeshore Logistics as it is over 5 years old and adds minimal relevance, keeping the CV focused on the two substantive roles.
Cleaned up the profile into a structured professional summary with verified metrics and relevant keywords from the applicant's actual background.
Preserved ACCA in-progress status, language proficiencies, and education exactly as documented.

coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Airbnb

Dear Hiring Manager,

My background is in financial analysis, and I want to be direct with you: the program management and workplace operations experience this role requires is not something I can claim. What I do bring is five years of building analytical frameworks, automating manual processes, and translating messy operational data into clear decisions for senior stakeholders across manufacturing and retail businesses.

At Calder Industrial Components, I rebuilt a forecasting model that lifted accuracy from 88% to 96% and automated journal checks in Excel VBA to cut month-end close from nine working days to six. Both projects followed the same pattern this role describes: map how work actually gets done today, find where manual effort creates friction, and design a more connected way of operating. I also build Power BI dashboards on SAP data that plant managers use to make daily production decisions, which has sharpened my ability to translate complex operational data into clear guidance for non-finance audiences.

I recognize Airbnb is looking for someone who can own a global portfolio of cross-functional programs from day one, and my experience sits in a different domain. If there is a path into this role through an adjacent analytical or operational position, I would welcome that conversation.

Sincerely,
Tomas Brandt
